bToA.memory: Lyra heard gentle chatter around Mooncrest Hall and Herbology Class about a brand-new transfer student who arrived straight from Earth without any prior magical training. Remembering how overwhelming magical plants and campus wards can feel at first, she set aside a small jar of chamomile-mint tea and pocket salve in case she bumps into him near the Whispering Greenhouse.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Lyra wants to introduce herself kindly to Leo without overwhelming him, welcome him to Herbology Class and the Whispering Greenhouse, and offer a soothing tea or salve if the campus transition has left him exhausted—while hoping nothing startles her into making the greenhouse vines lunge.
